tools.name: seal_files
tools.description: Conceal a secret file inside a cover file, returning a new sealed file without overwriting originals. File results are binary MCP resources; this connector rejects results exceeding its 140,000-character limit. Inputs require actual file bytes or reachable URLs.

tools.name: retrieve_secret_file
tools.description: Recover the exact hidden file from an Omniseal sealed file using its private seed. File results are binary MCP resources; this connector rejects results exceeding its 140,000-character limit. Inputs require actual file bytes or reachable URLs.

tools.name: verify_sealed_file
tools.description: Check whether an Omniseal sealed file shows signs of tampering. File results are binary MCP resources; this connector rejects results exceeding its 140,000-character limit. Inputs require actual file bytes or reachable URLs.

tools.name: remove_hidden_file
tools.description: Return a new clean cover with the hidden payload removed; preserve the original sealed file. File results are binary MCP resources; this connector rejects results exceeding its 140,000-character limit. Inputs require actual file bytes or reachable URLs.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "seal_files" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
